Hello. I'm a recent college grad working on starting my first business selling stickers.

I want to do two things with my business. The first is to be a low cost sticker retailer. It's hard to find a sticker retailer selling for less than ~$2.50 a sticker, and quite a few places sell for $4+. I think that's ridiculous for an adhesive piece of paper, and my stickers will cost between $1 and $2, never higher. In keeping with the low price theme, I will only be offering the most basic of shipping options, $0.49 in the US and $1.15 internationally.

The second thing I want to do with my business is connect with artists and other content creators. By putting an image or icon of theirs on a sticker, they can get some extra revenue to fund their creativity without having to worry about printing or order handling. Artists can choose whether to sell their stickers for $1 or $2 and will have their royalty rate adjusted accordingly. Unlike other online sticker retailers that rely on people coming to them, I will be actively seeking people out to put their images on stickers.

I will be officially opening my store on June 1st, but until then I am having a prelaunch giveaway at http://swagstickerslaunch.kickoffpages.com/ It does require an email address so that I can contact you about where to ship.
